title: spec(ui/page): the app page `record` binding's describe and PageRecordBindingSchema TSDoc still say "Planned in the renderer", though the console reads it
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTqqeHSwZYJmApbDCa

Filing gate: ① a false published sentence at named locations, found by the dev of PR #30611 (card #30094, report 6665354382) and outside that claim's file surface (the card's ruling was ledger data only, no schema). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` ships (`src/**/*.zod.ts` is in the package), and its `.describe()` text feeds the generated reference pages and the AI authoring surfaces. Both sentences below tell an author that a page-level `record` binding does nothing on an app page. The console reads it (PR #30611 regrades every `props.record.*` liveness row `live` with the readers named), so an author or agent following the describe would not use a binding that works.

## What the code says (at `origin/main` `4831d500`)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` :856-857, the `PageRecordBindingSchema` TSDoc: "Planned in the renderer: until the console mounts this binding, `record` stays unbound on an app page, as it was before the key existed."
- the same file :2003, the `record` key's `.describe()`: "… Planned in the renderer: until the console mounts it, `record` stays unbound on an app page."
- The reader on `main`: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx#appPageRecordBinding` (:88) → `AppPageRecordGate` / `AppPageRecordRead` (:147, :208; first row as `$top: 1` under `sort`) → `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx#PageRecordScope` (:392) → `ui/packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx#buildNodeEvaluationScope` (:699), which every component's `visibleWhen` reads; pinned by `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.appPageRecord-12931.test.tsx`.

## Wanted

- Replace both sentences with what the console does: an app page's binding is read once per page open, the first row under `sort` under the caller's identity, and every component's `visibleWhen` sees it as `record` (a record block that binds its own row still overrides `record` for its subtree). No shape, default or export change.
- Regenerate the reference pages the describe feeds (`gen:docs`; `check:generated` green). `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- Serial: after PR #30611 merges, so the describe and the ledger say the same thing on `main`.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open "Planned in the renderer"` → 2 hits (#30094, the ledger card; #6015, the triage seat post); `PageRecordBindingSchema` → 1 hit (#30094). **New.**

Suggested-grade: p3 · published wording only; the behaviour is already right.
